instruction: A quarry spoil pile and access road as a clean terrain object: an irregular conical heap of loose rock/gravel on an undulating ground plane, with a graded access road cutting past its base. Meter scale, north-up, earthy tones.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a quarry spoil pile and access road. A quarry spoil pile and access road as a clean terrain object: an irregular conical heap of loose rock/gravel on an undulating ground plane, with a graded access road cutting past its base. Meter scale, north-up, earthy tones. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
